recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, symmetrical 3D render of a weathered, industrial gas pump against a dark, atmospheric background. The pump features a vibrant orange lower panel, metallic textures, and glowing orange internal lights, creating a high-contrast, gritty urban aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the left and right fuel hoses framing the central pump body.
Contrast between the bright orange focal panel and the dark, textured metallic frame.
Relationship between the glowing internal light sources and the reflective metallic surfaces.
coreInvariants: Vibrant orange as the primary accent color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The fuel pump is centrally positioned, occupying approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large orange rectangular panel in the lower half of the pump.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the glowing top display, moves down the metallic structure to the orange panel, and follows the curved hoses back up.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black/dark brown void surrounding the pump, emphasizing its silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and metallic frame)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant safety orange (lower panel and glowing lights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright orange/white elements and the low-value dark surroundings.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning to create a block-like visual unit
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospace or condensed sans-serif for secondary technical labels.
graphicDevices: Circular emblem/logo centered above the main text
Parental advisory style badge at the bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the industrial, wide, and slanted aesthetic.
Provides the same geometric, square-off feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D render of a weathered, industrial gas pump centered in a dark studio. The lower half features a large, flat orange panel. The pump has two black hoses on the sides and glowing orange lights in the top display area. The metal should look scratched and oily.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white, bold, extended italic sans-serif text centered on the orange panel. Place a circular logo above it and a black-and-white advisory badge at the very bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the orange panel vibrant and high-contrast?
Is the main text heavily slanted and wide?

mustRedesign: Exact text strings from the original
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text appears to be printed on the pump surface, not floating.
Check that the lighting from the top display casts realistic shadows.
Verify the symmetry of the hoses.
Confirm the orange panel is the primary visual anchor.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Object + Symmetrical Framing + High Contrast Accent Color + Bold Extended Typography
